spf.comment: Penybont's 32-11 Cymru Premier record and home stability outweigh Cardiff Draconians' Tier 2 counter threat, pointing to a 3:0 or 3:1 home victory.

score.comment: 3:0 reflects Penybont's consecutive clean sheets and attacking edge, while 3:1 covers a transition consolation from Gullick or Cawley.

goals.comment: Three goals fits a controlled home shutout win, with four goals capturing an open cup script if the visitors breach Penybont once.

bqc.comment: Penybont's early pressure favors leading at half-time and full-time, while Draw-Win covers an initial Draconians low block breaking after the interval.
